title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Tort Liability Law of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Tort Liability Law of the People's Republic of China

Fa Fa [2010] No. 23

To: All high people's courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Tort Liability Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Tort Liability Law) shall come into force as of July 1, 2010. In order to correctly apply the Tort Liability Law, notice is hereby given on relevant issues as follows:

1. For civil dispute cases arising from tortious acts occurring after the Tort Liability Law comes into force, the provisions of the Tort Liability Law shall apply. For civil dispute cases arising from tortious acts occurring before the Tort Liability Law comes into force, the legal provisions in force at the time of the act shall apply.

2. For civil dispute cases where the tortious act occurred before the Tort Liability Law comes into force but the damage consequences appeared after the Tort Liability Law comes into force, the provisions of the Tort Liability Law shall apply.

3. Where a people's court applying the Tort Liability Law to try a civil dispute case conducts a medical damage appraisal upon a party's application or ex officio, the appraisal shall be organized in accordance with the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Issues Concerning Judicial Appraisal Management, the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Administration of Work Such as Commissioned Appraisal, Evaluation, and Auction by the Supreme People's Court, and the relevant provisions of the state authorities.

4. Where a people's court applying the Tort Liability Law to try a civil dispute case, if the victim has persons to be supported, the living expenses of such persons shall be included in the disability compensation or death compensation in accordance with Article 28 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Personal Injury Compensation Cases.

If any other major issues arise in the course of applying the Tort Liability Law by people's courts at all levels, please report them to this Court level by level in a timely manner.

June 30, 2010
